summary: @servicetitan/docs-uikit preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as documentation-only (package.json declares files: ["docs"]) but ships two undeclared JavaScript files at the tarball root: setup.mjs and math_init.js. package.json's preinstall hook invokes `node setup.mjs`, which is itself obfuscated (hex-name identifiers, string-indirection dictionaries) and downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then execFileSyncs the downloaded Bun binary against the sibling math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727 KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (rotated string-array decoder, hex identifiers) whose behavior is not documented. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern (fetch Bun, execute an opaque bundle under it) evades Node-level supply-chain instrumentation, and the payload files are not listed in the package's declared publish surface. This code runs automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
